verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on a live event debugger, per-destination delivery metrics, or delivery-failure alerting. The community items describe Segment's internal delivery architecture (Centrifuge job partitioning), not a user-facing observability feature. Pipeline observability is a fair question for a customer data pipeline, so the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can watch events flow live and diagnose delivery failures per destination — debugger views, delivery metrics, and alerting
